text:
maya-marketing: Quick ask for the launch blog + webinar: we need a compact verification bundle we can attach to the post and hand to reporters.

sam-runtime: Happy to run this. What does marketing need in the bundle exactly?

maya-marketing: Minimal but verifiable: 4 canonical payloads (tiny, short, mid, long), timings CSV (p50/p95/p99), one cold-start trace, one steady-state trace, and a one-paragraph runnote (warmup, batching, concurrency). Also a 1-line press blurb with the exact p95 we'll quote.

priya-eng: Which model and infra? Demo or headline model?

maya-marketing: Use rwd-demo-2b on a dedicated GPU (dedicated-gpu-12) if available. If not, run hosted and annotate caveats. Sequence distro we want mirrored: 50% <=64, 30% 65-512, 20% 513-2048.

sam-runtime: Plan: three micro-sweeps (N=300 each) to give a stable median p95, batching OFF, 30 warmup. I'll provide per-sweep CSVs and a combined summary with median and CV. If CV for p95 > 8% we'll mark gate=FAIL.

alex-demo: Please include demo/run-local.sh with a copy-pasteable curl and exact env variables for laptop demos. Must be zero-friction.

sam-runtime: Will include: export RW_KEY=<KEY> and curl example. Also a tiny docker command for reporters: docker run --rm -e RW_KEY=$RW_KEY redwood/bench-minirun --model rwd-demo-2b --payloads payloads.csv --runs 3

maya-marketing: Important: if int8 quantized run is included and shows >12% delta vs fp16 at p95, label quantized results 'preliminary' and include raw traces. We must not overclaim.

sam-runtime: Agreed. We'll run fp16 baseline and int8 quick-check. If int8 noise, it will be annotated.

bench-bot: micro-audit queued (#88123) by sam-runtime. Logs: /audit/88123.

maya-marketing: ETA? Editorial needs the bundle for tomorrow morning review.

sam-runtime: Kicking now. ETA ~5h. If anything fails gating, I'll ping immediately and include raw per-sweep artifacts.

bench-bot: micro-audit #88123 completed. Artifacts uploaded: /audit/88123/artifacts.tar.gz (sha256: 0f1e2d3c). Summary: median p95 = 158 ms (over 3x300 sweeps), p95 CV = 0.061 (PASS), int8 delta = +10% (labeled preliminary). Outlier: one long-payload spike at 410 ms annotated and excluded from median.

maya-marketing: Fantastic. Can you drop a press_blurb.txt with the raw number we can copy?

sam-runtime: press_blurb.txt included: "Measured on rwd-demo-2b (dedicated-gpu-12), median p95 = 158 ms over 3x300-request sweeps; batching disabled. See artifacts for per-sweep detail and provenance." Link: /audit/88123/artifacts.tar.gz

priya-eng: One small request for the README: include sequence length histogram counts and the exact commands used to run each sweep (so external reporters can reproduce).

sam-runtime: Done. README includes counts per bucket, kernel/driver/docker tags, warmup count, and the exact run commands.

maya-marketing: Perfect, thanks all. We'll review the artifacts and loop you in if editorial needs clarifications. :rocket:
